checks.detail: Page must match frozen sequence 0, pair, arm, size, result index, and shared runId.
Selected page must match the frozen sequence schedule.
Harness must PASS on frames 61–300 with 240 samples, eight structural frames, and finite nonnegative timing fields.
All five correctness checks must be true and harness/browser errors empty.
Baseline, post-teardown, and post-GC Runtime.getHeapUsage fields must be finite and nonnegative.
Mounted lifecycle must show size writers plus 8×8=64 structural mounts/cleanups, followed by zero writers and balanced teardown.
Each page must serve exactly the locked common files plus its selected arm, with no opposite-arm resource.

Collector flattened-tree representation must match an independent preorder traversal of the raw CDP tree.
Saved summary must equal independent aggregation of node.selfSize by URL, function name, line, and column; inclusive parent sizes are not summed.
Saved flat CDP samples must exactly preserve raw profile.samples.
Every emitted production excerpt must match the locked served asset hash and independently recomputed line/column offsets and text.
